title: PyTorch Generalization
summary: A PyTorch implementation for studying the gap between training and test performance.
problem: Can the margins between class scores help predict how well a classifier will generalize?
approach: Implemented the method from Yiding Jiang’s “Predicting the generalization gap in deep networks with margin distributions.”
impact: Trained 35 CIFAR-100 models to benchmark the implementation.

title: Adapter Monitoring
summary: Two studies on using LoRA adapter weights to monitor model behavior.
problem: Can adapter weights help detect violations missed by reasoning traces or flag adapters before they generate a response?
approach: Score the weights of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) modules with GLNet. One experiment combines that score with a reasoning trace for each answer. The other scores each adapter before it answers.
impact: Adding weights raised detection from 211 to 393 of 407 violations. In a separate screening test, GLNet flagged all 12 held-out policy adapters and none of the 12 benign adapters.
